questions.text: State De Morgan’s law for NOT (A AND B), and give an example showing both sides agree.

answer.text: For A=1 and B=0 both expressions equal 1

questions.text: A circuit uses Y = A AND (NOT B). List the input combinations producing 1.

answer.text: A must be 1 and B must be 0

questions.text: Explain why a truth table can be used to check two circuits are equivalent.

answer.text: Compare their outputs on every row; identical outputs imply equivalent Boolean functions

questions.text: How can a NAND gate implement NOT A?

answer.text: Connect A to both NAND inputs
